import sys
from collections import defaultdict

MOD = 10**9 + 7

def mod_pow(base, exp):
    result = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            result = (result * base) % MOD
        base = (base * base) % MOD
        exp >>= 1
    return result

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    N = int(input[0])

    node_id_map = {}

    prob_array = [0] * (1 << N)

    def set_bit(bitset, pos):
        return bitset | (1 << pos)

    def get_bit(bitset, pos):
        return (bitset >> pos) & 1

    def dfs(x):
        nonlocal total_nodes
        if x in node_id_map:
            return node_id_map[x]
        total_nodes += 1
        node_id_map[x] = total_nodes
        id = total_nodes
        tmp = [0] * N
        for i in range(N):
            for j in range(1 << N):
                if get_bit(j, i):
                    tmp[i] |= x[j]
        trans_table[id] = {}
        for mask in range(1 << N):
            temp = x
            for j in range(N):
                if get_bit(mask, j):
                    temp = temp | tmp[j]
            trans_table[id][mask] = dfs(temp)
        return id

    start = 1
    start_mask = 1  # only bit 0 set
    start_x = start_mask
    node_id_map = {}
    total_nodes = 0
    start_id = dfs(start_x)
    inv100 = mod_pow(100, MOD - 2)

    print(len(node_id_map))
    # Read P matrix
    # Already read above

    dp_state = [defaultdict(int), defaultdict(int)]
    current_layer = 0
    dp_state[current_layer][start_id] = 1

    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(1 << N):
            p_val = P[i][0] if get_bit(j, 0) else 100 - P[i][0]
            prob_array[j] = (inv100 * p_val) % MOD
            for k in range(1, N):
                p_val = P[i][k] if get_bit(j, k) else 100 - P[i][k]
                prob_array[j] = (prob_array[j] * p_val) % MOD
        next_layer = 1 - current_layer

    final_mask = (1 << N) - 1
    final_id = node_id_map.get(final_mask, None)
    print(dp_state[current_layer][final_id] if final_id is not None else 0)
